text:
mia_cs: :wave: Quick check — CUSP pilot seat scheduling and ops pulse. We have 10 seats remaining across the cohort and need to finalize kickoff dates, the pre-kickoff survey, and the enablement artifacts. Tagging @sam_ae @jordan_prod for commercial/readiness visibility and @lia_eng for the feature-flag work.

sam_ae: Which customers are actually on the list right now?

mia_cs: Current roster (confirmed + pending):
- BlueTide (confirmed)
- AtlasEdge (pending)
- CuspHealth (confirmed)
- Meridian Labs (pending)
- EmberWorks (confirmed)
- NovaGrid (pending)

jordan_prod: Recommend we stagger two onboarding blocks next week (Wed AM / Thu PM) to spread the support load. Pre-kickoff = 15m intro + 10m survey. Also propose reserving 2 seats for customers who need extended ramp.

lia_eng: Noted. I'll flip "feature_cusp_v1" on for the orgs once we have the final list. FYI there is a small infra deploy tomorrow that touches routing; if that lands, I can finish the flag rollout by EOD.

amanda_ops: I'll update the ops checklist with a "renewal-risk" monitor — if org hasn't completed setup in 14 days we escalate to AE. Also will draft calendar invites and workspace provisioning steps.

pilotbot: Reminder: BlueTide kickoff tentatively scheduled for 2024-07-12 16:00 PDT. Add confirmation to thread once consent received.

mia_cs: Draft outreach message to customers (send after we confirm slots):
```
Hi <Customer>,
Thanks for joining the CUSP pilot. Quick logistics: pick one of these kickoff slots (Wed 9:30AM PDT or Thu 3:00PM PDT). Please complete this 10-question pre-kickoff survey (5 mins) so we can tailor the session.
Link: https://forms.redwood.example/cusp-prework
We’ll provision your seats in the console once you pick a slot.
Thanks! — Mia (CS)
```

sam_ae: Suggest we tweak the survey to include 1) primary use-case, 2) expected QPS, 3) compliance notes. One more ask: add a short renewal sentiment question (are you likely to continue after pilot?).

jordan_prod: Agree. Also add a technical signal: "Is latency > 200ms for your critical calls? (yes/no)" — helps prioritize routes for the pilot.

lia_eng: Will add the flag gating and a small telemetry label so we can query adoption for those orgs. I’ll also push a tiny dashboard for the team: seat completion, survey complete %, and infra warnings.

amanda_ops: Ops ETA: invites + provisioning by EOD today once @sam_ae confirms final list. I’ll add the 14-day follow-up workflow in PagerDuty and tag the AE.

mia_cs: Action items: @sam_ae — finalize confirmed list by 6pm; @lia_eng — enable flags and telemetry after list; @amanda_ops — send invites + update ops checklist; @jordan_prod — finalize enablement deck + tech Qs. I’ll follow up Thu morning with a rollup.

sam_ae: On it, will DM the final list in ~1 hour.

lia_eng: Noted, will schedule flag rollout after your DM.

amanda_ops: Copy, will queue invites.

pilotbot: Kickoff plan doc created: https://docs.redwood.example/cusp-kickoff-plan (access permissions: customer-success, product, eng).

mia_cs: Great — thanks team :thumbsup: If anyone sees a high-risk customer (low survey completion or repeated scheduling no-shows) call it out here and we’ll escalate.

sam_ae: Will flag AtlasEdge if they don't respond in 48h — they had procurement constraints last month.

jordan_prod: I'll include a short rollback/fallback note in the deck in case they hit unexpected latency.

lia_eng: One quick FYI — the routing deploy may add transient 5-10s cold starts for some pods for 30m after deploy. I’ll post an alert if we see anything abnormal.

amanda_ops: Logged the 14-day renewal-risk play in ops tracker (ID: OPS-3221).

mia_cs: Thanks all — follow-up Thurs.

pilotbot: Thread marked resolved by mia_cs.
